newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela quake death toll rises to 20 - official.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela quake death toll rises to 20 - official.

text.p: At least 20 people were killed in a strong earthquake that shook Venezuela's central and eastern coastal region on Wednesday afternoon, Civil Defense officials said.

Caracas Civil Defense Director said at least 15 died in the small Caribbean town Cariaco in eastern Venezuela and another five were killed in the historic city Cumana, 255 miles (408 km) east of Caracas.

Director Francisco Daboin said three buildings had collapsed in Cariaco, including two schools. The deaths in Cumana were the result of the collapse of a large office building in the center of town, Daboin told local Radio Caracas Radio.
There were 30 people injured in Cariaco and 27 in Cumana, he said.

The quake struck at about 3:25 p.m. (1925 GMT) and measured 5.5 on the Richter scale, FUNVISIS seismological institute officials in Caracas said. The epicenter was about 30 miles (49 km) off Venezuela's northeastern Caribbean coast, they said.
Daboin said rescue efforts had been hampered because telephone lines were down in the area and contact was limited to radio.
